882108924.accepts_evidence: Two programs. Honors Awards: an open, competitive annual application through an online portal (three awards a year). Community Impact Grants: by invitation only, though the site says a nonprofit may email the Foundation to propose a program. https://texascapitalbank.com/foundation
882108924.contact: No named grants contact; foundation email is on the page but could not be read (obfuscated). General contact page: https://texascapitalbank.com/helpful-information/contact-us
882108924.deadlines: Honors Awards 2026 cycle: portal opens Oct 12, 2026; closes Nov 15, 2026; nine finalists notified Jan 25, 2027; pitch day Feb 24, 2027; recipients announced May 2027. Community Impact Grants: allocated annually, no public deadline.
882108924.eligibility: Texas-based nonprofits delivering direct services; 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(4) status, active in IRS Publication 78; Honors Awards programs need at least a three-year track record; financial statements, board list and org chart required; small and mid-sized nonprofits are prioritized. Community Impact Grants must meet Community Reinvestment Act requirements.
882108924.geographic_limits: Texas only: organizations serving low- and moderate-income communities in Dallas, Fort Worth, Austin, Houston or San Antonio.
882108924.grant_range_stated: Honors Awards: $50,000 (Housing Solutions), $50,000 (Education and Workforce Development), $100,000 (Star Honors Award for veterans and first responders). Community Impact Grant amounts vary by market.
882108924.how_to_apply: Honors Awards: apply in the YourCause online portal during the annual window. Community Impact Grants: invitation only; a nonprofit may email the Foundation with a program idea (address on the foundation page).
882108924.name: Texas Capital Foundation
882108924.not_funded: Honors Awards: political or controversial advocacy, individuals, for-profits, municipalities, membership and fraternal groups, groups not mainly serving low- to moderate-income communities, ticketed events (luncheons, golf, galas). Community Impact Grants also exclude public or private schools, places of worship, PACs and lobbying groups. No regranting to other nonprofits.
882108924.notes: The foundation page carries both an 'applications now open' banner and a line saying the 2026 cycle is closed; by the published timeline the 2026 portal closes Nov 15, 2026, two days after this check. Only three Honors Awards are made per year; most dollars go out through the invitation-only Community Impact Grants. Community Impact Grant guidelines PDF is linked from the foundation page (not read).
882108924.page_dated: 2026 Honors Awards cycle dates shown; footer copyright 2003-2026.
